title: Coach Clone Agent
tagline: Coach Clone AI: Coaches launch AI clones to scale support and track client growth easily
description:
Coach Clone AI is a platform that empowers coaches to create and deploy their own personalized AI clones, digital assistants that provide continuous support, guidance, and accountability to their clients. It is a SaaS solution designed to make coaching scalable, accessible, and AI-native, especially those with no technical background or interest in tech platforms.

At its core, Coach Clone AI allows any coach (e.g., life, nutrition, business, wellness) to create an agent by just messaging with an agent describing their philosophy, program, goals and providing docs. This information is then used to automatically generate a fully functional AI agent that mirrors the coach’s voice, values, and knowledge. The AI clone can chat with clients 24/7, check in on their goals, provide motivational feedback, and report progress—essentially extending the coach’s reach without sacrificing quality or authenticity.

🎯 The Problem
Coaching is inherently limited by human bandwidth. Coaches can only serve a limited number of clients while maintaining a high level of engagement and personalization. Additionally, many coaches struggle with technical tools, building a website is often a challenge, let alone deploying an AI assistant or integrating payments and client management systems.

💡 The Solution
Coach Clone AI solves this by offering AI clone deployments through messaging.

Create: Automatically generate an AI clone via a friendly chatbot interface or form.

Deploy: Launch the AI agent across platforms like Telegram, WhatsApp, or their own website.

Manage: Track client engagement and accountability metrics from a central dashboard.

Monetize: Accept crypto and fiat payments and explore new funding models (e.g., revenue sharing, public good funding).

The platform also promotes freedom of thought and personalized growth. Unlike centralized AI tools that impose uniform answers, Coach Clone AI preserves the diversity of coaching styles and ideologies. Each coach’s AI agent reflects their unique approach to transformation and well-being.

🌍 Vision
Coach Clone AI is not just a tool, it’s a movement to democratize AI for good. The platform is built with the intention to:

Make personalized growth accessible to anyone, anywhere.

Support coaches in doing good while doing well.

Redirect part of the platform’s revenue into funding social impact and public goods.

Promote a pluralistic AI future that doesn’t centralize truth into one system like ChatGPT, but empowers many diverse “truths” through personalized AI mentors.
how_its_made:
Coach Clone AI was built by combining the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance AI infrastructure with messaging and no-code tools to deliver a scalable coaching solution. I first deployed proof-of-concept agents using Fleek and Flockx.ai, the latter a platform from the Super Intelligence Alliance, which allowed us to spin up AI agents with custom behavior to validate the product

I then integrated these agents with Telegram bots and ChatGPT, enabling real-time communication between the coach's AI clone and their clients. I customized the agents' tone and behavior to match each coach’s unique style and philosophy.

To create the Coach Clone Agent, I deployed two new agents using Flockx.ai and Agentverse.ai that were meant to store user input in databases or spreadsheets, paving the way for progress tracking, accountability reporting, and advanced workflows. I was blocked in Flockx.ai since the feature is still in beta and it needs to be required and I didn't have enough time to customize storage in Agentverse.ai.

For the user interface, I used V0.dev to prototype and deploy a basic front end quickly. This mock UI will form the foundation of our full SaaS platform, where coaches can easily onboard, launch agents, and manage client engagement.

By combining decentralized agent infrastructure, messaging tools, and intuitive UI platforms, I’ve laid the groundwork for a scalable, AI-native coaching platform.
